beats.label: S1 · The scholarship kids
beats.text: Public school scholarship students Samuel, Nadia and Christian arrive at Las Encinas and are immediately marked as outsiders by Guzmán, Lu and their circle.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the class conflict that drives every relationship and murder motive in the series.

beats.label: S1 · A bet becomes real
beats.text: Guzmán bets Lu he can take Nadia's virginity; Nadia catches him, and only forgives after he publicly begs her Muslim family, but real feelings take root.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the Guzmán–Nadia romance that carries through the next two seasons.

beats.label: S1 · Marina between brothers
beats.text: Marina begins a relationship with Samuel but also sleeps with his ex-con brother Nano, hiding that she is HIV positive and pregnant by Nano.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The love triangle behind the flash-forward murder mystery.

beats.label: S1 · The stolen watches
beats.text: Marina helps Nano steal watches from Carla's father to pay his debt — one holds evidence of the father's crimes, and Carla and Polo panic to get it back.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Provides the motive that turns a party fight into a murder.

beats.label: S1 · Polo kills Marina
beats.text: Polo confronts Marina about the watch and, in a panic, kills her with her own trophy; Carla coaches him through the story to give the police.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The core secret that Samuel spends the next two seasons trying to expose.

beats.label: S1 · Nano takes the fall
beats.text: Police arrest Nano for Marina's murder, leaving the three real killers untouched.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the wrongful arrest and Samuel's mission that opens S2.

cliffhanger.text: Nano is in a cell for a murder Polo committed. Only Polo, Carla and Christian know the truth; Samuel is left grieving Marina and certain the wrong man is going down.
questions: Can Samuel prove his brother's innocence?
How long will Polo hold up under his own guilt?
What is Carla's father hiding on the missing watch?

characters.name: Samuel García
characters.line: Scholarship kid whose brother has been framed for the murder of the girl he loved.

characters.name: Guzmán Nunier
characters.line: Marina's brother, wrecked by grief, in love with Nadia after their bet turned real.

characters.name: Nadia Shanaa
characters.line: Muslim scholarship student, secretly in love with Guzmán, her family's honour bruised.

characters.name: Marina Nunier
characters.line: Killed by Polo with her own trophy; was HIV positive and pregnant by Nano.

characters.name: Polo Benavent
characters.line: Killed Marina in a panic over the stolen watch; shielded by Carla and Christian.

characters.name: Carla Rosón
characters.line: Rich heiress who orchestrated Polo's cover-up to protect her father's secrets.

characters.name: Nano García
characters.line: Samuel's brother, arrested for the murder despite fathering Marina's child, not killing her.

characters.name: Christian Varela
characters.line: Working-class kid entangled with Carla and Polo.

characters.name: Lu Montesinos
characters.line: Guzmán's cruel ex, humiliated by his shift to Nadia and hungry to reclaim him.

characters.name: Ander Muñoz
characters.line: Guzmán's best friend, secretly dating Omar; the principal's son.

characters.name: Omar Shanaa
characters.line: Nadia's closeted brother and small-time dealer, in love with Ander.

beats.label: S2 · Three new faces
beats.text: Three months after Marina's death, new students arrive: influencer Cayetana, Lu's incestuous half-brother Valerio, and lottery-rich Rebeka.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the trio that reshapes the ensemble through S3 and beyond.

beats.label: S2 · Christian is silenced
beats.text: Christian tries to go to police to name Marina's killer but is run down by a car — likely arranged by Carla's father; he survives but never walks again.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes the only outside witness and shows how dangerous Carla's father is.

beats.label: S2 · Samuel seduces Carla
beats.text: Samuel seduces Carla to draw out the truth about Marina; the guilt breaks Polo, who confesses to Ander and then tries to kill himself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The seduction plot is the whole engine of the season's mystery.

beats.label: S2 · Guzmán vs Samuel
beats.text: Samuel realises Polo is the killer from a shirt swap at the party, but Guzmán refuses to believe him and they brawl at school.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Fractures Guzmán and Ander's friendship and drives S3's uneasy alliance.

beats.label: S2 · Samuel's fake vanishing
beats.text: Samuel fakes his own disappearance to scare Carla into publicly naming Polo as Marina's killer; the police arrest Polo at last.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's payoff and the reason Polo is on trial as S3 opens.

beats.label: S2 · The weapon in the closet
beats.text: Two weeks later Polo returns to school with charges dropped for lack of evidence — and Cayetana is quietly hiding the trophy that killed Marina in her closet.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts the physical evidence in Cayetana's hands and reopens the case for S3.

cliffhanger.text: Polo has walked free and returned to Las Encinas, hated by everyone but untouchable. Cayetana is sitting on the murder weapon — and knows exactly what she has.
questions: Will Cayetana use the trophy against Polo or protect him?
Can Samuel and Guzmán trust each other after the beating?
How far will Carla's father go to keep his secrets buried?

characters.name: Samuel García
characters.line: Solved Marina's murder, briefly dated Carla, still obsessed with taking Polo down.

characters.name: Guzmán Nunier
characters.line: Betrayed by Ander for hiding the truth; now openly gunning for Polo.

characters.name: Nadia Shanaa
characters.line: Back with Guzmán after her sex tape leaked, forgiven by her parents.

characters.name: Polo Benavent
characters.line: Exposed as Marina's killer but legally free; socially destroyed and self-hating.

characters.name: Carla Rosón
characters.line: Confessed to Polo's guilt and drifted toward Samuel; blackmailed by her father.

characters.name: Ander Muñoz
characters.line: Kept Polo's secret to protect him; lost Guzmán's friendship, still with Omar.

characters.name: Omar Shanaa
characters.line: Kicked out by his father and living openly with Ander.

characters.name: Cayetana Grajera
characters.line: Exposed as the school cleaner's daughter; hiding the trophy that killed Marina.

characters.name: Valerio Montesinos
characters.line: Lu's incestuous half-brother.

characters.name: Rebeka de Bormujo
characters.line: Lottery-rich newcomer whose mother is a real drug dealer; carrying a torch for Samuel.

characters.name: Lu Montesinos
characters.line: Caught in the affair with Valerio; still ruthless, now vulnerable to exposure.

beats.label: S3 · Polo walks again
beats.text: Under her father's threat, Carla retracts her testimony and the case against Polo collapses; he returns to Las Encinas, hated by everyone but legally safe.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets the murder plot and forces the group to hunt him outside court.

beats.label: S3 · Ander's diagnosis
beats.text: Ander is diagnosed with leukemia and pushes Omar away all through chemo, culminating in a devastating fake-cheating breakup.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ander's illness is the emotional spine of the season and defines his path forward.

beats.label: S3 · New suitors, new fronts
beats.text: Rich returning student Yeray becomes Carla's arranged partner, and Senegalese Malick charms Nadia's family, pulling her toward him and away from Guzmán.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the couples that carry into S4 and the Nadia-leaves-Spain resolution.

beats.label: S3 · Hunting Polo
beats.text: Samuel and Guzmán ally to break Polo — kidnapping, fake Twitter confessions, and constant harassment until Polo tells his own mothers he killed Marina.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The pressure campaign directly causes Polo's confession and, indirectly, his death.

beats.label: S3 · Lu kills Polo
beats.text: At the graduation party, Lu accidentally stabs Polo with a broken bottleneck during a fight; he bleeds out and falls from a club balcony to his death.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the Marina murder arc and creates the group's shared secret.

beats.label: S3 · Everyone covers
beats.text: The group plants their fingerprints on the bottle to frame Polo's death as suicide; Polo's mothers reinstate the scholarships and the killers walk free.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the moral compromise the survivors carry into S4.

cliffhanger.text: Polo is dead, ruled a suicide only because everyone lied. Nadia and Lu leave for New York with Malick; Samuel, Guzmán, Rebeka, Ander and Omar return to Las Encinas under a new principal.
questions: Will Lu's guilt over killing Polo eventually break the cover-up?
Can Ander's remission hold?
Who fills the power vacuum Polo, Nadia and Lu leave behind?

characters.name: Samuel García
characters.line: Helped hunt and then cover for Polo's killer; single, returning for senior year.

characters.name: Guzmán Nunier
characters.line: Forgave Polo at his death; still grieving Marina, staying at Las Encinas.

characters.name: Ander Muñoz
characters.line: In remission, back with Omar after his fake cheating story fell apart.

characters.name: Omar Shanaa
characters.line: Reconciled with Ander; skipped New York with Nadia to stay by his side.

characters.name: Rebeka de Bormujo
characters.line: Expelled and then reinstated; mother out of jail, done with the drug trade.

characters.name: Cayetana Grajera
characters.line: Made peace with her roots; now the cleaning lady at Las Encinas.

characters.name: Valerio Montesinos
characters.line: Running the wineries for Carla, still Cayetana's occasional lover.

characters.name: Polo Benavent
characters.line: Stabbed by Lu and framed as a suicide; his death is the group's shared secret.

characters.name: Nadia Shanaa
characters.line: Left for New York on Polo's mothers' scholarship, with Malick and Lu.

characters.name: Lu Montesinos
characters.line: Killed Polo and got away with it; also gone to New York, sharing the scholarship.

beats.label: S4 · A new principal, three new heirs
beats.text: Strict new principal Benjamin Commerford arrives with three children — controlling Ari, secretly-escorting Mencía, and reckless Patrick — reshaping every friendship.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Commerfords are the season's centre of gravity and drive every S5 plotline.

beats.label: S4 · The prince's secret
beats.text: Prince Phillipe transfers in with a buried rape allegation; he films Cayetana without consent, and when she confronts him he nearly rapes her in his limo.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up Phillipe's public reckoning and his fraught redemption arc in S5.

beats.label: S4 · Ari between two men
beats.text: Ari sleeps with both Guzmán and Samuel and openly refuses to give either up, fracturing the friendship the two had barely rebuilt.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The triangle that ends Guzmán's arc and cements the Ari–Samuel couple for S5.

beats.label: S4 · Mencía and Armando
beats.text: Mencía is trapped in escort work under Armando, a wealthy predator who blackmails and beats her; Rebe uncovers it and grows desperate to save her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Armando thread is the murder that everything in S5 revolves around.

beats.label: S4 · Guzmán kills Armando
beats.text: Confronting Armando alone, Ari is beaten unconscious into a pool; Guzmán tracks Armando down and shoots him dead with a flare gun.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The killing that becomes S5's central police investigation.

beats.label: S4 · Body in the lake, exits stage left
beats.text: Samuel and Rebe help Guzmán dump Armando's body in the lake; Guzmán and Ander then leave Las Encinas together, Guzmán blessing Ari and Samuel as a couple.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts the body where S5 will find it, and removes two originals from the cast.

cliffhanger.text: Armando's body is at the bottom of the lake, shared secret of Samuel, Rebe and Guzmán. Ari and Samuel are officially together, and both Guzmán and Ander are gone.
questions: How long until Armando's body surfaces?
Can Phillipe truly reform, or will he flee?
What will Benjamin do now that the man who abused his daughter is dead?

characters.name: Samuel García
characters.line: In love with Ari, complicit in dumping Armando's body in the lake.

characters.name: Ari Blanco
characters.line: Benjamin's eldest, in love with Samuel, freshly recovered from Armando's assault.

characters.name: Mencía Blanco
characters.line: Benjamin's middle child, freed by Armando's death and opening up to Rebe.

characters.name: Patrick Blanco
characters.line: Benjamin's pansexual son, chasing whichever of Ander and Omar hurts him most.

characters.name: Benjamin Commerford
characters.line: Strict principal and single father, now knowing his daughter's abuser has vanished.

characters.name: Phillipe of Cantabria
characters.line: Prince with a history of sexual assault, privately confessing to one prior victim at last.

characters.name: Cayetana Grajera
characters.line: Cleaner-turned-Phillipe's-ex, victim of his aggression, holding him to account.

characters.name: Rebe de Bormujo
characters.line: Helped dump Armando's body; falling for Mencía, protective of her.

characters.name: Omar Shanaa
characters.line: Working at Las Encinas, waiting for Ander after their split-and-repair.

beats.label: S5 · The next class arrives
beats.text: New students Iván and rich socialite Isadora enter Las Encinas while Phillipe faces public condemnation from his old victim and vows to redeem himself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Iván and Isadora, both central to every remaining season.

beats.label: S5 · Armando surfaces
beats.text: Armando's body floats to the top of the lake, launching a police investigation that quickly closes in on Benjamin — linked to Armando via a secret second phone.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The mystery that consumes the season and forces the false confession.

beats.label: S5 · Samuel takes the fall
beats.text: Under Benjamin's promise of lifelong financial security, Samu falsely confesses to Armando's murder and is arrested; Iván, not Benjamin, quietly bails him out.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The sacrifice sets up Samu's death and Iván's arc into next season.

beats.label: S5 · Ibiza
beats.text: In Ibiza three students drug and rape Isadora after Iván and Phillipe pass out trying to stop them; Phillipe convinces Isadora to report the assault.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The rape and its trial are the driving plot of S6.

beats.label: S5 · Samu cracks his head
beats.text: The police enlist Samu to trap Benjamin; when Benjamin lunges for the SIM card, Samu slips by the pool, cracks his head open and dies.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Samu's death is the absence that defines S6 and Ari's grief.

beats.label: S5 · Benjamin arrested
beats.text: Ari, Mencía, Patrick, Rebe and Omar all turn on Benjamin over Samu's body; the police arrest him, and Iván reconciles with his father Cruz.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends Benjamin's control and locks in the Cruz–Iván bond that S6 shatters.

cliffhanger.text: Samu is dead by Benjamin's hand, and Benjamin is finally under arrest. Isadora's rape case is heading to trial, Iván has just come out and reconciled with his father Cruz, and the Commerford siblings are learning to live without their father.
questions: Will Isadora's rapists actually be convicted?
How does this group survive without Samuel at its centre?
Now that Cruz knows Iván is gay, what does public life look like for both of them?

characters.name: Ari Blanco
characters.line: Samu's grieving girlfriend; helped bring her own father down for killing him.

characters.name: Mencía Blanco
characters.line: Freed from Armando and her father both; in love with Rebe.

characters.name: Patrick Blanco
characters.line: Chased his father Cruz over Iván all season; ends the season comforted by Iván after Benjamin's arrest.

characters.name: Iván Carvalho
characters.line: Cruz's son, out and in a fragile relationship with Patrick.

characters.name: Isadora Artiñán
characters.line: Club-going socialite and Ibiza rape survivor, now preparing to face her rapists.

characters.name: Rebe de Bormujo
characters.line: In love with Mencía; helped dispose of Armando and expose Benjamin.

characters.name: Omar Shanaa
characters.line: Barely functioning after Ander's absence and Samu's death.

characters.name: Cruz Carvalho
characters.line: Star footballer and Iván's father, just accepted his son's sexuality.

characters.name: Benjamin Commerford
characters.line: Arrested for Samu's death; awaiting trial, family shattered.

beats.label: S6 · Repeating the year
beats.text: Ari, Mencía and Patrick repeat their year as new students arrive: influencer Sara with abusive boyfriend Raúl, transgender Nico, servant Dídac and hippie Rocío.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the Sara/Raúl thread and every new face carrying into S7.

beats.label: S6 · Rapists acquitted
beats.text: Isadora's three rapists are acquitted, but Dídac secretly records one of them, Javier, confessing — and the guilt of what he knew starts eating at him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets Dídac's alignment with Isadora that defines his S7 arc.

beats.label: S6 · Cruz comes out, then dies
beats.text: Cruz publicly comes out as gay after Patrick takes the blame for kissing him; days later Cruz is brutally murdered by three homophobic men.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cruz's murder is the blow that fractures Iván and Patrick for the rest of the series.

beats.label: S6 · Iván spirals, ruins Patrick
beats.text: Iván blames Patrick for Cruz's death and breaks up with him; a hookup with Ari deepens the wound, and Iván begins an open downward spiral.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains where Iván and Patrick each stand at the top of S7.

beats.label: S6 · Ari lets her father go
beats.text: Ari agrees to testify for her jailed father Benjamin, then reneges before trial and, four months late, finally visits Samu's grave.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends Benjamin's hold on his daughter and closes the Samu grief loop.

beats.label: S6 · Iván's accident
beats.text: At Isadora's carnival night, Iván is left gravely injured by a serious accident, while Alex and Hugo's assault of Isadora catches up to them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Iván's injury and Sara's secret drive the whole opening of S7.

cliffhanger.text: Iván is fighting for his life after a serious accident. Cruz is dead, Patrick is alone, and Dídac and Isadora are quietly becoming something more.
questions: Will Iván recover, and how much will he remember?
How long can Sara stay silent about causing the accident?
Can Isadora and Dídac survive the war between their families?

characters.name: Iván Carvalho
characters.line: Gravely injured at season's end; grieving Cruz, estranged from Patrick.

characters.name: Patrick Blanco
characters.line: Blamed for Cruz's death and dumped by Iván; adrift and heartbroken.

characters.name: Ari Blanco
characters.line: Cut ties with her father Benjamin; finally grieving Samu openly.

characters.name: Mencía Blanco
characters.line: With Rebe; refused to defend Benjamin, worried about Sara's abuse.

characters.name: Isadora Artiñán
characters.line: Club owner denied justice for her rape; growing close to Dídac in secret.

characters.name: Dídac Martos
characters.line: Servant-turned-student from a rival wealthy family; secretly in love with Isadora.

characters.name: Sara
characters.line: Influencer trapped with Raúl.

characters.name: Raúl
characters.line: Sara's abusive influencer boyfriend, controlling her every move.

characters.name: Nico
characters.line: Transgender new student, quietly steady inside the chaos.

characters.name: Rocío
characters.line: Hippie tattoo artist.

beats.label: S7 · Iván recovers, Sara stays silent
beats.text: Iván recovers from the accident while Sara, sick with guilt over causing it, is bullied into silence by her abusive boyfriend Raúl.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Sara-caused-it secret is the ticking bomb under half the season.

beats.label: S7 · New faces, buried ties
beats.text: Delivery boy Joel, Nico's suicidal cousin Eric and party girl Chloe arrive; Chloe is later revealed as Iván's half-sister via her mother Carmen.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces every new lead, and the Carmen–Iván family bombshell.

beats.label: S7 · Iván takes Omar's boyfriend
beats.text: Iván falls for Joel, Omar's boyfriend; Omar catches them in his own bed, ending his relationship and cracking his fragile mental recovery.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cements Iván–Joel and pushes Omar back into therapy.

beats.label: S7 · A mother in the wrong bed
beats.text: High on drugs, Carmen mistakes Iván for his dead father Cruz and almost has sex with her own son before fleeing in horror.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The moment that permanently defines Iván's relationship with his biological mother.

beats.label: S7 · The undercover cop
beats.text: Head of studies Luis is exposed as an undercover officer; Dídac secretly agrees to help him build a baby-trafficking case against Isadora's father Martín.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the Martín takedown and the final Isadora–Dídac rupture.

beats.label: S7 · Carmen kills Raúl
beats.text: Sara publicly exposes Raúl; when Raúl attacks Chloe, Carmen shoves him off a balcony to his death, and she and Chloe stage the scene as a suicide.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the Sara–Raúl arc and creates the final hanging secret.

beats.label: S7 · Martín falls, Dalmar watches
beats.text: Isadora tricks Martín into a taped confession and he is arrested — but Dalmar has secretly filmed Carmen killing Raúl and is holding the video, undecided.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The final image of the show: one family destroyed, another crime hidden.

cliffhanger.text: Martín is under arrest, Raúl is dead and Isadora refuses to take Dídac back after his betrayal. Carmen killed Raúl to save Chloe, and Dalmar is sitting on the video, unsure what to do with it.
questions: Will Dalmar release the tape of Carmen killing Raúl?
Can Isadora ever forgive Dídac for helping the police?
Now that Iván has chosen himself, what is left between him and Joel?

characters.name: Iván Carvalho
characters.line: Recovered from the accident; chose himself over Joel and the South Africa exchange.

characters.name: Ari Blanco
characters.line: Grieving Samu properly at last; done with her father, closer to her siblings.

characters.name: Isadora Artiñán
characters.line: Brought down her own father Martín; refuses Dídac despite what they built.

characters.name: Dídac Martos
characters.line: Worked with the police against Martín, hoping to win Isadora and losing her.

characters.name: Omar Shanaa
characters.line: Back in therapy after Joel and Iván; slowly rebuilding.

characters.name: Joel
characters.line: Left Omar for Iván, stayed at Las Encinas on Iván's money, now alone.

characters.name: Chloe Vargas
characters.line: Iván's half-sister; escaped Raúl and now lives with her mother Carmen.

characters.name: Sara
characters.line: Finally free of Raúl by his death; her role in Iván's accident still unspoken.

characters.name: Carmen Vargas
characters.line: Iván's biological mother; killed Raúl to protect Chloe, framed it as suicide.

characters.name: Dalmar
characters.line: Omar and Joel's flatmate; the sole witness with video of Carmen killing Raúl.
